Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: 20 TB Raw Domain Pretraining & Continual SFT Corpus (~5 Trillion Raw Tokens -> 3.1T High-Quality Unique Tokens)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Legacy Pure-CPU Apache Spark Cluster (JVM Shuffle + GraphFrames Connected Components)
Configuration_Matrix.Execution_Engine: 128x 64-vCPU Cloud VMs; Disk-Spilling JVM Shuffle on MinHash LSH Buckets
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern for >5 TB corpora: LSH bucket shuffle and graph connected components OOM on JVM

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: HuggingFace Datatrove on Slurm / Spot CPU Workers (Exact + Bucketed MinHash CPU)
Configuration_Matrix.Execution_Engine: Memory-Mapped Cython/Rust Streaming on Spot CPU Nodes (No Semantic Dedup)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Cost-effective CPU-only lexical dedup when GPU quota is unavailable for Semantic Dedup

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Monolithic All-On-GPU Pipeline (Running HTML/Regex Parsing + MinHash + SemDeDup All on H100s)
Configuration_Matrix.Execution_Engine: 32x H100 GPUs Running Both CPU-Bound Text Extraction and GPU-Bound LSH
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Fast wall-clock turnaround, but wastes expensive H100 GPU hours during CPU-bound HTML/PDF regex parsing

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Ray Data Heterogeneous Streaming + NVIDIA NeMo Curator (`cuDF/cuGraph` MinHash + `FAISS` SemDeDup + Classifier)
Configuration_Matrix.Execution_Engine: Spot CPUs for HTML/PII Regex -> Streaming Arrow Zero-Copy to 16x L40S/A100 GPUs for cuGraph LSH & SemDeDup
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for 10TB–100TB LLM data pipelines (cuts curation time by 91.8% and net cost by 73.2%)
